custom.css references ../webfonts/DroidSans-webfont.svg#droid_sansregular in the Droid Sans @font-face src list.
The SVG file appears alongside regular Droid Sans EOT, WOFF2, WOFF, and TTF files and is referenced in the same @font-face declaration.
custom.css groups the regular Droid Sans files under the same @font-face source list.
